abstract: OBJECTIVE: In order to understand the prognostic factors of placental site trophoblastic tumors (PSTT), we performed a MEDLINE search for cases from 1976 through 1998 and report three cases. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The patients' age at presentation, antecedent pregnancies, and responses to treatment were analyzed according to the extent of disease, disease status after treatment, and survival in 88 cases. RESULTS: Patients with disease extending outside the uterus at presentation had a median latency of 24 months between the antecedent pregnancy and presentation of PSTT, which was significantly longer than that of 12 months in those with disease confined to the uterus. Patients with metastatic diseases were 3 years older than patients with diseases confined to the uterus and had a higher incidence of term delivery as their antecedent pregnancy. The outcomes of patients with FIGO stage I-II disease after hysterectomy were excellent, while those with FIGO stage III-IV diseases had a 30% survival. Although initial partial responses to chemotherapy were observed in some patients, only 5 patients achieved a complete remission and 3 of these 5 received a combination of etoposide, methotrexate, and actinomycin-D, alternating with cyclophosphamide and vincristine. CONCLUSION: FIGO stage is the most important prognostic factor, and complete removal of all lesions provided good outcomes in PSTT patients. For those with unresectable tumors, combination chemotherapy showed a high response rate, but only a few achieved a complete response.
abstract_ja: 目的：胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の予後因子を理解するため、1976年から1998年までの症例についてMEDLINEを検索し、3例を報告する。材料と方法：88例について、初診時年齢、先行妊娠、治療への反応を、病変の広がり、治療後の疾患状態、生存率に従って解析した。結果：子宮外に病変が及んでいた患者では、先行妊娠からPSTTの初診までの潜伏期間の中央値が24か月で、子宮内に限局していた患者の12か月より有意に長かった。転移性疾患の患者は子宮内に限局していた患者より3歳年長で、先行妊娠として正期産の割合が高かった。FIGO病期I-IIの患者は子宮摘出後の成績が優れていたが、FIGO病期III-IVの患者の生存率は30%であった。一部の患者では化学療法に対して部分奏効が認められたが、完全寛解に至ったのは5例のみで、そのうち3例はエトポシド、メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンDの併用療法を受け、シクロホスファミドとビンクリスチンを交互に併用されていた。結論：FIGO病期が最も重要な予後因子であり、病変の完全切除により良好な転帰が得られた。切除不能な症例では、併用化学療法により高い奏効率が得られたが、完全奏効が得られた症例は少数であった。
